newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal bonds lose but outperform Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Portugal bonds lose but outperform Bunds.

text.p: 1625 GMT - Bonds closed down but off lows and succeeded in narrowing the spread with Spain and the Bunds. Opening on Monday to be dictated by U.S. Treasury performance. *Sept 97 futures down 49 at 110.45 vs Thursday close *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.37 vs 102.73. Yld 6.28 vs 6.23 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 67 vs 70
